title: Deliver counted bytes through host and accelerator stdout
problem: Long output and percent signs must reach stdout without reinterpretation as format syntax.
design: A bounded sink emits counted chunks. Backend printf uses fixed conversion formats; compatibility hooks receive safe escaped pieces.
tradeoffs: Some backend or legacy transports cannot preserve embedded NULs and report errors. Host captures validate contracts, not accelerator runtime behavior.
reading_order: test/capture.hpp:raw stream equality after parsed diagnostics
source_changes: Preserve original byte-counted transport and restore aeff raw stdout equality regression in the legacy capture helper. Portable legacy-host checks ensure this stricter harness remains valid before migration.
